title: Project scaffold
instruction: Create full project scaffold with backend, frontend, database, docs, Docker, CI, env examples, and smoke tests.

title: Backend core implementation
instruction: Implement real backend business code: entities, repositories, DTOs, services, controllers, validation, exceptions, migrations, and tests. No placeholders.

title: Authentication and security
instruction: Implement OTP auth, JWT auth, refresh tokens, role selection, RBAC, security filter, rate limits, and tests.

title: Domain features
instruction: Implement requested domain features end-to-end with business rules, database constraints, APIs, and tests.

title: Frontend application
instruction: Implement real React UI, routing, auth guards, forms, API integration, state handling, error/loading states, and Playwright tests.

title: Integration and deployment prep
instruction: Wire frontend/backend contracts, Docker, CI, env docs, deployment checklist, run instructions, and fix integration gaps.

title: Quality gate
instruction: Run real quality checks. Fail if placeholders exist, builds fail, tests fail, security is weak, or required business logic is missing.

title: Fix quality failures
instruction: Fix all QA failures with real code. Do not hide or downgrade failures.

title: Final QA
instruction: Re-run quality checks and confirm production readiness.

title: Memory update
instruction: Update project memory, task status, QA report, run index, and next actions.

title: Delivery report
instruction: Create final delivery report with implemented features, run commands, test results, deployment checklist, and risks.
